entries.en: The conservator tested the resolvent on a hidden patch of varnish.
entries.zh: 修复师在一块隐蔽的清漆表面试用了这种溶剂。

entries.en: The staff tree had wound itself around the old iron railing.
entries.zh: 这株南蛇藤属植物已缠绕在旧铁栏杆上。

entries.en: The sample contained nitric bacteria rather than the yeast we expected.
entries.zh: 样本里含有硝化细菌，而不是我们预期的酵母菌。

entries.en: The diagram showed a nitro group attached to the benzene ring.
entries.zh: 示意图显示苯环上连着一个硝基。

entries.en: The noctuid moth rested beneath a folded curtain at noon.
entries.zh: 那只夜蛾中午停在一道窗帘的褶皱下面。

entries.en: The gardener left the nodding onion untouched when trimming the border.
entries.zh: 修剪花坛边缘时，园丁没有碰那株垂花葱。

entries.en: Mira moved the non-flowering plant away from the hot window.
entries.zh: 米拉把那株不开花植物从炙热的窗边移开了。

entries.en: A fallen branch from the northern red oak blocked our gate.
entries.zh: 那棵北方红栎掉落的一根树枝挡住了大门。

entries.en: Snow bent the northern white cedar over the garden path.
entries.zh: 积雪把那株西方金钟柏压弯，垂到了花园小径上方。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the northern whiting to swim past the camera.
entries.zh: 摄影师等着那条北方无鳔石首鱼游过镜头前。

entries.en: She pulled up the nut grass before laying the new paving stones.
entries.zh: 铺新石砖前，她拔掉了香附子。

entries.en: We spread a blanket beneath the nut tree and unpacked our lunch.
entries.zh: 我们在那棵坚果树下铺开毯子，取出了午餐。

entries.en: The young nutmeg tree needed a stronger stake after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，那株幼小的肉豆蔻树需要更结实的支桩。

entries.en: The child kept an oak apple in the same box as her acorns.
entries.zh: 小女孩把一颗栎五倍子与她收集的橡子放在同一个盒子里。

entries.en: An owl watched us from a hollow in the oak tree.
entries.zh: 一只猫头鹰从橡树的树洞里注视着我们。

entries.en: The microbiologist transferred an obligate anaerobe into the sealed culture vessel.
entries.zh: 微生物学家把一种专性厌氧菌移入密封的培养容器。

entries.en: A visiting student sketched the obstetrical toad in the glass tank.
entries.zh: 一名来访学生画下了玻璃缸里的那只产婆蟾。

entries.en: The diver's photograph captured an ocean pout beneath a ledge.
entries.zh: 潜水员的照片拍到了岩架下的一条美洲大绵鳚。

entries.en: An ocean sunfish appeared in the aquarium's largest viewing window.
entries.zh: 一条翻车鲀出现在水族馆最大的观景窗前。

entries.en: The fishmonger placed the oceanic bonito on a fresh bed of ice.
entries.zh: 鱼贩把那条鲣放在新铺的一层冰上。

entries.en: I flattened the odd-pinnate leaf between two sheets of absorbent paper.
entries.zh: 我把那片奇数羽状复叶压平，夹在两张吸水纸之间。

entries.en: The keeper guided the injured odd-toed ungulate into a wider pen.
entries.zh: 饲养员把那只受伤的奇蹄目动物引进了更宽敞的圈舍。

entries.en: A leaking bottle of oil of cloves scented the entire cupboard.
entries.zh: 一瓶漏液的丁香油使整个橱柜都散发着香味。

entries.en: The storm stripped several fronds from the oil palm outside the office.
entries.zh: 风暴刮掉了办公室外那棵油椰子的几片叶子。

entries.en: The road bends sharply before reaching a stretch of old growth.
entries.zh: 这条路在到达一片原始林之前急转了一个弯。

entries.meaningZh: 长尾鸭〔旧鸟名，含冒犯性用语〕
entries.en: The old squaw in the faded photograph was resting beside a wooden decoy.
entries.zh: 褪色照片中的那只长尾鸭正停歇在一只木制诱鸟旁。

entries.en: Our grandmother tied a blue ribbon to the olive tree by the gate.
entries.zh: 祖母在门边那棵油橄榄树上系了一条蓝丝带。

entries.en: He crouched to photograph the one-flowered wintergreen without crushing nearby plants.
entries.zh: 他蹲下拍摄那株独丽花，小心不压坏附近的植物。

entries.en: The gardener removed several plants badly affected by onion mildew.
entries.zh: 园丁拔掉了几株受葱霜霉病严重侵害的植物。

entries.en: The grower marked the rows showing signs of onion smut.
entries.zh: 种植者标出了出现洋葱黑粉病症状的那几垄作物。

entries.en: An onion thrips crawled across the underside of the leaf.
entries.zh: 一只葱蓟马在叶片背面爬过。

entries.meaningZh: 类似玛瑙的条纹大理石〔石材名〕
entries.en: The stonemason polished a panel of onyx marble for the entrance hall.
entries.zh: 石匠给门厅用的一块类似玛瑙的条纹大理石板抛了光。

entries.en: The tailor cut a narrow strip of ooze leather for the cuff.
entries.zh: 裁缝剪下一条窄窄的植鞣绒面革，用来做袖口。

entries.en: The watercolor showed a single opium poppy beside a stone wall.
entries.zh: 那幅水彩画画的是石墙边的一株罂粟。

entries.en: Several opossum shrimp darted away when the lamp lit the tank.
entries.zh: 灯光照亮水缸时，几只糠虾迅速游开了。

entries.en: The technician inspected the optical crown for tiny bubbles.
entries.zh: 技术员检查这块光学冕玻璃有没有微小气泡。

entries.en: A scratch on the optical crown glass spoiled the unfinished lens.
entries.zh: 冕光学玻璃上的一道划痕毁了那枚尚未完工的镜片。

entries.en: The workshop stored optical flint separately from its ordinary window glass.
entries.zh: 工坊把火石光学玻璃和普通窗玻璃分开存放。

entries.en: The orange tortrix escaped just before I lowered the net.
entries.zh: 我刚要放下网，那只甜橙卷叶蛾就逃走了。

entries.en: The mower left a narrow strip of orchard grass beside the fence.
entries.zh: 割草机在围栏旁留下了一窄条鸭茅。

entries.en: Her orchid cactus stood on a shelf above the kitchen sink.
entries.zh: 她的令箭荷花摆在厨房水槽上方的架子上。

entries.en: The horticulturist moved several members of the orchid family into the display house.
entries.zh: 园艺师把几株兰科植物搬进了展览温室。

entries.en: Please close the bag of organic fertilizer before putting it in the shed.
entries.zh: 请先封好这袋有机肥料，再把它放进棚屋。

entries.en: Warm light shone through the thin shade of oriental alabaster.
entries.zh: 暖色的灯光透过那只薄薄的条带状大理岩灯罩。

entries.en: They planted an oriental cherry outside the new library.
entries.zh: 他们在新图书馆外种了一株樱花。

entries.en: An oriental cockroach disappeared into the crack behind the cupboard.
entries.zh: 一只东方蜚蠊钻进了橱柜后面的缝隙。

entries.en: The orthopterous insect jumped from my sleeve before I could photograph it.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及拍照，那只直翅目昆虫就从我袖子上跳走了。

entries.en: The student adjusted the microscope to examine the orthotropous ovule.
entries.zh: 学生调整显微镜，观察那个直生胚珠。

entries.en: A cracked pot left the roots of the oval kumquat exposed.
entries.zh: 花盆裂了，使那株金桔的根露了出来。

entries.en: We watched an oyster catcher through binoculars without leaving the path.
entries.zh: 我们没有离开小路，用双筒望远镜观察了一只蛎鹬。

entries.en: The chef sliced the oyster mushroom into a bowl beside the stove.
entries.zh: 厨师把那朵侧耳切成片，放入炉边的碗里。

entries.en: The old pagoda tree casts a shadow across the school gate.
entries.zh: 那棵老槐树的影子横映在学校大门上。

entries.en: The painted turtle climbed onto the stone while we watched quietly.
entries.zh: 我们静静看着那只锦龟爬上石头。

entries.en: Rinse the pak choi before adding it to the simmering broth.
entries.zh: 把小白菜洗净后再放入微沸的汤里。

entries.en: The palm civet turned its head toward the keeper's footsteps.
entries.zh: 那只椰子猫听到饲养员的脚步声，转过了头。

entries.en: The nursery reserved this glasshouse for plants in the palm family.
entries.zh: 苗圃把这座温室留给了棕榈科植物。

entries.en: She weighed the palm kernel on a small laboratory balance.
entries.zh: 她用一台小型实验室天平称了那颗棕仁。

entries.en: A string of lights hung between the palm tree and the balcony.
entries.zh: 一串灯挂在那棵棕榈树和阳台之间。

entries.en: The palmate leaf left a clear impression in the soft clay.
entries.zh: 那片掌状叶在软泥上留下了清晰的印痕。

entries.en: The workers built a low wall around the palmyra palm.
entries.zh: 工人们在那棵糖椰周围砌了一道矮墙。

entries.en: The painter left the pampas grass out of her first sketch.
entries.zh: 画家在第一张素描中没有画那丛蒲苇。

entries.en: A broken ladder leaned against the papaya tree behind the house.
entries.zh: 一架坏梯子靠在屋后的蕃木瓜树上。

entries.en: Rain dripped from the paper birch onto our tent all night.
entries.zh: 整整一夜，雨水都从那棵纸皮桦上滴到我们的帐篷上。

entries.en: Nora folded a paper flower and fastened it to the gift box.
entries.zh: 诺拉折了一朵纸花，把它固定在礼盒上。

entries.en: The surveyor placed a marker beside the paper mulberry, away from its roots.
entries.zh: 测量员在构树旁放了一个标记，避开了它的根。

entries.meaningZh: 纸带〔早期计算机存储介质〕
entries.en: The operator fed the punched paper tape into the old computer's reader.
entries.zh: 操作员把打孔纸带送入那台老式计算机的读取器。

entries.en: The chemist compared three compounds from the paraffin series during the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验中，化学家比较了石蜡系中的三种化合物。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the parasitic plant before collecting a small sample.
entries.zh: 植物学家先拍下了那株寄生植物，再采集少量样本。

entries.en: The researcher placed the parasitic worm in a shallow dish for examination.
entries.zh: 研究员把那条寄生虫放在一个浅皿中检查。

entries.en: Her drawing of the opened ovary clearly showed parietal placentation.
entries.zh: 她画的剖开子房图清楚地展示了侧膜胎座式。

entries.en: The mushroom's partial veil tore as the cap expanded.
entries.zh: 随着菌盖展开，这朵蘑菇的不完全菌幕裂开了。

entries.en: The filter trapped particulate matter before the air entered the chamber.
entries.zh: 空气进入舱室前，过滤器截留了其中的颗粒物质。

entries.en: She shaded the pasque flower with her umbrella while taking a close-up photograph.
entries.zh: 她拍摄特写时，用伞给那株白头翁遮住了直射光。

entries.en: The museum moved its passenger pigeon specimen into a sealed display case.
entries.zh: 博物馆把候鸽标本移入了一个密封展柜。

entries.en: The gardener grouped plants from the passionflower family along the central walkway.
entries.zh: 园丁把西番莲科的植物集中摆放在中央步道旁。

entries.en: The delivery truck left the paving material beside the unfinished driveway.
entries.zh: 运货卡车把铺路材料卸在尚未完工的车道旁。

entries.en: He split a pea pod open with his thumbnail.
entries.zh: 他用拇指指甲掰开了一个豌豆荚。

entries.en: We moved the bench so it would not crush the young pea tree.
entries.zh: 我们挪开长凳，以免压坏那株幼小的锦鸡儿。

entries.en: A pea weevil crawled out of the opened seed packet.
entries.zh: 一只豌豆象从打开的种子袋里爬了出来。

entries.en: The peach bell bent under the weight of the fallen twig.
entries.zh: 落下的小树枝压弯了那株桃叶风铃草。

entries.en: My brother rescued the kite caught in our peach tree.
entries.zh: 我的兄弟取下了挂在我家桃树上的风筝。

entries.en: The gardener lifted the peanut vine carefully with a fork.
entries.zh: 园丁用园艺叉小心地掘起那株花生藤。

entries.en: The carpenter built the new fence around the pear tree instead of removing it.
entries.zh: 木匠让新围栏绕过那棵梨树，没有把树移走。

entries.en: The worker scooped pearl ash from the sack into a weighing pan.
entries.zh: 工人从袋中舀出珍珠灰，放进称量盘。

entries.en: The children drew the pearl millet growing beside the school garden.
entries.zh: 孩子们画下了学校菜园旁生长的御谷。

entries.en: The diver placed the pearl oyster gently in the basket.
entries.zh: 潜水员把那只珍珠贝轻轻放进篮子里。

entries.en: Stir the pearl sago slowly so it does not stick to the pan.
entries.zh: 慢慢搅动珍珠西米，免得粘锅。

entries.en: A small clump of pearly everlasting remained after the workers cleared the path.
entries.zh: 工人清理小路后，还留下了一小丛香青。

entries.en: The pearly nautilus drifted beyond the camera's narrow field of view.
entries.zh: 那只鹦鹉螺漂出了相机狭窄的视野。

entries.en: The botanist collected a small living sample of peat moss.
entries.zh: 植物学家采集了一小份活的泥煤苔样本。

entries.en: The fish's left pectoral fin brushed the aquarium glass.
entries.zh: 那条鱼的左胸鳍擦过了鱼缸玻璃。

entries.en: The pectoral sandpiper stood still long enough for Elena to focus her camera.
entries.zh: 那只斑胸滨鹬静立了一会儿，足够埃琳娜把相机对好焦。

entries.en: She traced the pedate leaf onto a page in her sketchbook.
entries.zh: 她把那片鸟足状叶的轮廓描在了素描本的一页上。

entries.en: Water collected in a shallow hollow on the peltate leaf.
entries.zh: 水积在了那片盾状叶上一个浅浅的凹处。

entries.en: The photograph showed a small tear in the fish's pelvic fin.
entries.zh: 照片显示那条鱼的腹鳍上有一道小裂口。

entries.en: A pair of gardeners braced the pencil cedar with wooden supports.
entries.zh: 两名园丁用木支架撑住了那棵铅笔柏。

entries.en: The collector donated several plants from the pepper family to the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 收藏者向温室捐赠了几株胡椒科植物。

entries.en: She noticed pepper grass between the paving stones near the back door.
entries.zh: 她注意到后门附近的铺路石缝里长着独行菜。

entries.en: A delivery van scraped a low branch of the pepper tree.
entries.zh: 一辆送货车擦到了漆椒树的一根低枝。

entries.en: The pepper vine had slipped off its wooden support.
entries.zh: 那株胡椒从木支架上滑落了下来。

entries.en: The artist chose the peppermint gum as the central tree in her painting.
entries.zh: 画家选择杏仁桉作为画面中央的树。

entries.en: Heavy boots had flattened the perennial ryegrass beside the gate.
entries.zh: 沉重的靴子把门边的黑麦草踩倒了。

entries.en: The student turned the stem to inspect the perfoliate leaf from below.
entries.zh: 学生转动茎秆，从下方观察那片贯穿叶。

entries.en: A periodical cicada landed on the shoulder of my jacket.
entries.zh: 一只周期蝉落在了我的夹克肩部。

entries.en: We could see the persimmon tree through the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 透过厨房窗户，我们能看到那棵柿树。

entries.en: The pewit gull shook the water from its wings before taking off.
entries.zh: 那只红嘴鸥先抖掉翅膀上的水，然后飞走了。

entries.en: A pharaoh ant crossed the white tile beside the sink.
entries.zh: 一只法老蚁爬过了水槽旁的白色瓷砖。

entries.en: The last phoenix tree along the avenue stood behind a locked gate.
entries.zh: 林荫道上的最后一棵梧桐位于一扇锁着的大门后面。

entries.en: The machinist replaced the worn bearing with one made of phosphor bronze.
entries.zh: 机械加工师用一个磷青铜轴承换下了磨损的轴承。

entries.meaningZh: 光能利用细菌〔微生物学〕
entries.en: The team compared samples of phototrophic bacteria under controlled lighting.
entries.zh: 研究组在受控照明下比较了光能利用细菌的样本。

entries.en: Grandma cut the pie plant and carried the stalks into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 奶奶割下食用大黄，把茎秆拿进了厨房。

entries.en: The crane lowered the pig lead onto a reinforced platform.
entries.zh: 起重机把铅锭放到了一座加固的平台上。

entries.en: The piggyback plant was too large for the narrow windowsill.
entries.zh: 那株千母草太大了，窄窗台放不下。

entries.en: The pike perch slipped from the net and splashed back into the water.
entries.zh: 那条梭鲈从网中滑出，扑通一声落回了水里。

entries.en: The pill bug rolled into a ball when the child touched it.
entries.zh: 孩子一碰，那只球潮虫就蜷成了一个球。

entries.en: The geologist photographed the pillow lava beside the exposed rock face.
entries.zh: 地质学家在裸露的岩壁旁拍摄了枕状熔岩。

entries.en: Our neighbor asked us not to park beneath the damaged pin oak.
entries.zh: 邻居请我们不要把车停在那棵受损的针栎下。

entries.en: The children hung a bird feeder from the pine tree.
entries.zh: 孩子们在松树上挂了一个喂鸟器。

entries.en: The gardener found pineapple weed growing beside the broken paving slab.
entries.zh: 园丁发现那块破裂的铺路石板旁长着香甘菊。

entries.en: The technician lifted a pink bollworm from the sample with fine tweezers.
entries.zh: 技术员用细镊子从样本中夹出了一条棉红铃虫。

entries.en: A pinnate leaf caught in the spokes of her bicycle wheel.
entries.zh: 一片羽状叶卡在了她自行车轮的辐条间。

entries.en: The stone bench beneath the pipal tree was still wet from the rain.
entries.zh: 天竺菩提树下的石凳还被雨水浸湿着。

entries.en: The technician scraped pisang wax from the dish after it had cooled.
entries.zh: 香蕉蜡冷却后，技术员把它从皿中刮了下来。

entries.en: A pistol shrimp emerged briefly before retreating behind the rock.
entries.zh: 一只鼓虾短暂露面后，又退回了石头后面。

entries.en: Researchers compared a placental mammal with a marsupial of similar size.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了一种胎盘哺乳动物与一种体型相近的有袋类动物。

entries.en: The programmer preserved the order of siblings when drawing the plane tree.
entries.zh: 程序员绘制那棵有序树时，保留了兄弟节点的顺序。

entries.en: The water sample contained planktonic algae visible through the microscope.
entries.zh: 水样中含有可以通过显微镜观察到的浮游藻类。

entries.en: A plant bug clung to the rim of the watering can.
entries.zh: 一只盲蝽紧抓着洒水壶的边缘。

entries.en: The student drew a single plant cell from the stained slide.
entries.zh: 学生根据染色玻片画出了一个植物细胞。

entries.en: The restorer found a strand of plant fiber caught in the old frame.
entries.zh: 修复师发现旧画框里卡着一缕植物纤维。

entries.en: The weaver twisted the damp plant fibre into a thin cord.
entries.zh: 织工把湿润的植物纤维搓成一根细绳。

entries.en: She spilled some plant food while opening the packet over the potting bench.
entries.zh: 她在盆栽工作台上方拆袋时，撒出了一些植物肥料。

entries.en: The plant hopper jumped onto another leaf when I moved closer.
entries.zh: 我靠近时，那只飞虱跳到了另一片叶子上。

entries.en: Fossils from several branches of the plant kingdom filled the cabinet.
entries.zh: 展柜里摆满了植物界几个分支的化石。

entries.en: He brushed a plant louse off the rosebud with a soft paintbrush.
entries.zh: 他用软画笔把玫瑰花蕾上的一只蚜虫刷掉了。

entries.en: The sieve separated the plant material from the coarse gravel.
entries.zh: 筛子把植物物质与粗砾石分离开来。

entries.en: The researcher weighed each plant organ separately after drying the specimens.
entries.zh: 研究员将标本干燥后，分别称量了每个植物器官。

entries.en: The manufacturer replaced an animal ingredient with a plant product.
entries.zh: 制造商用一种植物产品替换了一种动物性原料。

entries.en: The blade crushed the plant tissue instead of making a clean cut.
entries.zh: 刀片没有把植物组织切齐，而是把它压坏了。

entries.en: The plantain lily beside the steps had been crushed by a fallen pot.
entries.zh: 台阶旁那株玉簪被掉落的花盆压坏了。

entries.meaningZh: 植鞭毛虫〔微生物学旧分类名〕
entries.en: A plantlike flagellate swam across the microscope's field of view.
entries.zh: 一只植鞭毛虫游过了显微镜的视野。

entries.en: We tied the hammock between the plum tree and a sturdy post.
entries.zh: 我们把吊床系在李树和一根结实的柱子之间。

entries.en: The narrow path disappeared behind a dense clump of plume grass.
entries.zh: 狭窄的小路消失在一丛茂密的蔗茅后面。

entries.en: The mason cut a small block from the plutonic rock.
entries.zh: 石匠从那块深成岩上切下了一个小石块。

entries.en: The pocket gopher vanished before the photographer could change lenses.
entries.zh: 摄影师还没来得及更换镜头，那只衣囊鼠就不见了。

entries.en: The pocket mouse paused at the edge of the observation box.
entries.zh: 那只囊鼠在观察箱边缘停了下来。

entries.en: The pocket rat left tiny footprints across the damp sand.
entries.zh: 那只囊鼠类动物在湿沙上留下了小小的脚印。

entries.en: The gardener fenced off the poison bush beside the path.
entries.zh: 园丁用围栏隔开了小路旁那株齿荚豆属的有毒植物。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the poison camas without disturbing the surrounding plants.
entries.zh: 植物学家拍摄了那株毒棋盘花，没有扰动周围的植物。

entries.en: The workers left the poison dogwood untouched while repairing the fence.
entries.zh: 工人修理围栏时，没有碰那株美国毒漆树。

entries.en: The caretaker moved the poisonous plant beyond the children's reach.
entries.zh: 管理员把那株有毒植物移到了孩子够不着的地方。

entries.en: Police sealed the barrel containing the poisonous substance before collecting samples.
entries.zh: 警方先封好装有有毒物的桶，再采集样本。

entries.en: The garden's new bed contains several members of the pokeweed family.
entries.zh: 花园的新花坛里种着几株商陆科植物。

entries.en: The polar hare moved out of sight before we reached the viewing platform.
entries.zh: 我们还没走到观景台，那只北极兔就消失在视野中了。

entries.en: A pole bean had climbed to the top of the wooden frame.
entries.zh: 一株攀缘茎类的豆已经爬到了木架顶端。

entries.en: The biologist measured the pollen tube in the magnified image.
entries.zh: 生物学家在放大图像中测量了花粉管。

entries.en: The groom led the tired polo pony back to its stable.
entries.zh: 马夫把那匹疲惫的马球马牵回了马厩。

entries.en: The engineer sent a sample of polybutylene to the materials laboratory.
entries.zh: 工程师把一份聚丁烯样品送到了材料实验室。

entries.en: A strand of polyester fiber caught on the needle.
entries.zh: 一缕聚酯纤维挂在了针上。

entries.en: The upholsterer cut the polyurethane foam to fit the chair seat.
entries.zh: 家具装饰工把聚氨酯泡沫体裁成了适合椅座的大小。

entries.en: The laboratory ordered sheets of polyvinyl chloride for the new test enclosure.
entries.zh: 实验室订购了聚氯乙烯板材，用来制作新的试验围罩。

entries.meaningZh: 聚乙烯基树脂〔工程材料〕
entries.en: The technician weighed the polyvinyl resin before mixing the test batch.
entries.zh: 技术员在混合这批试验材料前，称量了聚乙烯基树脂。

entries.en: The pomegranate tree by the courtyard wall needs a stronger support.
entries.zh: 院墙边那株石榴需要一个更结实的支架。
